## Checklist

- [ ] A test that fails before this change and passes after it (`npm test`)
- [ ] No new dependency; Node 20+ core modules only
- [ ] Nothing is written before the person accepts, and nothing outside NASO's markers is touched
- [ ] Says nothing where a file is absent: no placeholder, no assumed stack or host
- [ ] Works on macOS, Linux and Windows: no shell-only syntax, no hard-coded path separators
- [ ] No organization, project, person or ticket names in code, tests, docs or examples
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under the unreleased version
